name: Southern Grits
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: milk, enough with egg to equal 1 cup

instructions:
1 c grits, 1 tsp. salt
4 c water to cook grits in. Mix:
1/2 stick butter, 1 pkg garlic cheese.
Mix with cooked grits.
1 egg in cup with enough milk to equal 1 cup, beat, add 1/2 tsp red pepper.
Mix all in grits. Put in casserole, bake 300 for 40 min. Cover top with grated sharp cheese and leave in oven until melted.
